scope: specific source, feature, ABI and build consumers used by independent review; not an exhaustive process or repository inventory

conclusions.legacyRuntimeBuilder: Archives committed vm source; default feature set remains empty. Future committed overlays change archive digest even where feature-disabled.

conclusions.identity: Any newly built artifact/source snapshot requires fresh recorded digests; this review does not rebind old published artifacts or treat an old receipt as current.
